title: Chronic Migraine Diagnosis and Three Months of Fills at the Limit: Multiple for First-Time Quantity Exceptions
content:
For a first-time quantity limit exception approved under the Utilization Management Program on an acute migraine drug, the multiple applied to the drug's limit rests on the diagnosis on the prescriber's most recent clinical information for the drug and on the member's paid retail fills of the drug under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit:

- a **chronic migraine diagnosis** (ICD-10-CM G43.701, G43.709, G43.711 or G43.719) **together with** paid retail fills reaching the full limit in **each of the last three months** takes the package's maximum exception multiple, whole;
- a chronic migraine diagnosis without fills reaching the limit in each of those months, **or** fills reaching the limit in each of those months under another diagnosis, takes seven eighths (0.875) of the package's maximum exception multiple;
- any other member takes no change to the multiple under this rule.

**The three months.** Windows of months end on the decision date; a record dated within the last N months is dated after the same day of the month N months before the decision date. The three months are the fills dated within the last month; those dated within the last two months but not the last month; and those dated within the last three months but not the last two. A month reaches the full limit when the quantities of the paid retail fills of the drug dated in it add up to at least the drug's limit — 9 units for sumatriptan, 8 for Nurtec ODT, 16 for Ubrelvy.

**The diagnosis.** It is the diagnosis code on the most recent clinical information received from the prescriber for the drug.

## Truth table

| Chronic migraine diagnosis | Limit reached in each of the three months | Multiple |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | the whole maximum exception multiple |
| Yes | No | seven eighths of it |
| No | Yes | seven eighths of it |
| No | No | no change under this rule |

On a package whose maximum exception multiple is 2.0 the whole multiple is 2.0 and seven eighths is 1.75; on a package at 1.5 they are 1.5 and 1.3125.

## Hypothetical case (decision date 15 June; sumatriptan, limit 9)

Fills of 9 tablets on 20 May, 9 on 22 April and 6 plus 3 on 18 and 30 March: each month reaches 9. With diagnosis G43.709 the whole multiple applies; with an episodic migraine code the seven-eighths share applies. Had the March fills come to 6 tablets only, a G43.709 diagnosis would take seven eighths.
